notes: DEP-01 exception register for the docs-site npm audit (ADR 0009). One entry covers exactly one advisory (GHSA id) against one package, for the vulnerable range npm audit reports today. It stops applying when that range changes (a fixed release exists), when it expires, or when the advisory is critical. An entry lives at most 31 days; renewing it is a dated decision in the ADR's review log. Packages flagged only through other packages get no entries: they are covered by derivation. An entry whose advisory the audit no longer reports fails the gate until it is removed.
